test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Machinist) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is NOT correct for using scribers?

options.text: Place a cork on the point when in use to prevent accidents.
Scriber points are very sharp, so they are to be handled very carefully.
While scribing lines, the scriber is used like a pencil.
Do not put the scriber in your pocket.

solution:
The correct answer is __Place a cork on the point when in use to prevent accidents.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Scribers__ are pointed tools used to mark lines on metal surfaces for machining purposes.
 
• Scriber points are very sharp, and they should always be handled with care to avoid injuries.
 
• While scribing lines, the scriber is used like a pencil, maintaining proper control to achieve precision.
 
• It is unsafe to put the scriber in your pocket as it may cause accidental injuries.
 
• Placing a cork on the point of the scriber when in use is not a common or practical practice.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Safety Tips for Using Scribers:**

 
 
• Always place the scriber in a tool holder or box when not in use to ensure safe storage.
 
• Do not use a scriber for purposes other than marking to prevent damage to the tool.
